violations.description: Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. -Sani bucket found at ~100ppm Quat solution. *Had been made with 1/2 a tab, added other half to bucket to correct solution of 200ppm Quat. -Cloth left at side of bucket out of solution. *Corrected on-site, moved into sanitizer solution.

Sanitizing solution testing devices. — --Test strip or kit that accurately measures the sanitizing concentration was not provided. -Facility now using Quat sanitizer but only has chlorine test strips on-site.

General employee practices. — --Employee failed to maintain a high degree of personal cleanliness or observe proper hygienic practices. -Employee "blew" into gloves to make them easier to put on. *Redirected immediately to wash hands and get fresh gloves.
Properly designed, located, constructed, operated, maintained, cleaned and chemical test kit provided (2 pts deducted)
